source_defaults_frames: sample_rate + 512 (at least two default 2 Hz trigger events)
uniform_policy: Identical explicitly supplied f32 stream per frame, consumed only by the unchanged source call sites and the production Rust function. At most two draws: probability only when probability < 1; target only after acceptance with disconnected external voltage. No claim of parity with Rack's uncontrolled global PRNG.
lifecycle: Event 1 is source/host Initialize: apply source parameter defaults while retaining runtime. Event 2 constructs a fresh identity with fresh runtime. Event 3 and ordinary parameter changes retain runtime through production adopt. Source has no custom onReset override.
source_input_boundary: Rack cable bookkeeping zeroes all input slots at and above width, including slot zero of a disconnected port. The genuine class reads raw getVoltage(0); production receives poisoned inactive padding and must supply the equivalent zero boundary.
excluded_source_paths: Nonfinite values and computed internal rate outside [-120,120] are rejected by fixtures and adapter. Rack scalar exp2Floor uses float-to-int and signed shifts and has no defined arbitrary-input contract. The finite suite never reaches those paths. Shape zero's IEEE float division is defined and is included.
rationale: 20 microvolts plus 2 ppm bounds source libm interpolation rounding; phase and light budgets are 2 micro-units. Timer and pulse budgets are tight absolute f32 budgets. Exact clock/acceptance events, draw counts, Schmitt state and widths prevent voltage tolerance from hiding clock or lifecycle errors. No per-case relaxation, warmup, alignment, frame-count override or partial-suite qualification.
